literal: Flood-like resembling affliction, one who possesses wisdom, within the mind as he contemplates, will perish.
translation: Afflictions as vast as a flood will perish the moment a wise person calmly contemplates them within their mind.
modern: வெள்ளம் போன்ற பெரிய துன்பங்களும், அறிவுடையவன் தன் மனத்திற்குள் அவற்றை நினைத்து ஆராயும்போதே அழிந்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet describes the power of wisdom in overcoming immense difficulties. The phrase 'வெள்ளத்து அனைய இடும்பை' compares overwhelming troubles to a vast, sweeping flood. However, for a wise person ('அறிவுடையான்'), these massive problems do not cause despair. Instead, as they calmly contemplate and analyze the situation within their mind ('உள்ளத்தின் உள்ள'), the power of the affliction vanishes ('கெடும்'). The couplet teaches that mental clarity and thoughtful reflection can dissolve even the most formidable challenges.
